name: Running
alt: A runner's feet in Tide One on a riverside path in soft morning light
tagline: Light, cushioned and ready for daily miles.
intro: Two road shoes built around one idea: enough foam to protect your legs, not so much that the ground disappears. Tide One is the quicker daily trainer. Drift Knit is softer, for long runs and long shifts.
choose: Choose Tide One for a lighter, quicker feel and a heel that locks in.
Choose Drift Knit for the deepest cushioning and a sock-like knit fit.

guide.t: Match the foam to the distance
guide.p: Mostly under 10 km? Tide One. Regular long runs or all day on your feet? Drift Knit.
Feet swell on longer runs. Aim for about 1 cm between your longest toe and the front of the shoe.
The 60-day wear test covers road miles. Run in them properly before you decide.

name: Basketball
alt: A player laces Rally Mid high-tops on a wooden bench beside an indoor court
tagline: Court shapes with lockdown and grip.
intro: Leather court shoes with firm heel cups and herringbone outsoles. Rally Mid is the high-top for pickup games. Loop Strap adds a strap and a lower collar for studio, court and street.
choose: Choose Rally Mid for ankle support and the most grip on dusty floors.
Choose Loop Strap for a lighter mid-top you can wear off court too.

guide.p: On court, a heel that stays put matters more than soft foam. Lace to the top eyelet and check for heel lift.
Rally Mid runs half a size large. Loop Strap is true to size.

guide.t: Allow a week to break in
guide.p: Full-grain leather softens after three or four sessions. Wear them around the house first.

name: Training
alt: Moss green Yard Runner training shoes beside a kettlebell and a rolled mat in a sage studio
tagline: Low, stable shoes for the gym and the trailhead.
intro: Yard Runner sits low and wide for lifting and classes. Ridge Form adds suede, a toe bumper and 4 mm lugs for gravel paths and wet grass.
choose: Choose Yard Runner for lifting, classes and short runs on the treadmill.
Choose Ridge Form for towpaths, gravel and anything that gets muddy.

guide.p: A 4 mm drop and a flat base keep you planted under a bar. Save the thick foam for running.
Ridge Form grips on gravel and grass but stays quiet on pavement, so you can run to the trail.
Training wears the forefoot first. Both models can be resoled for ₹3,499.

name: Lifestyle
alt: Everyday Arc canvas sneakers with ecru trousers on a stone bench in a quiet city square
tagline: Pairs for every day that is not a run.
intro: Metro Quiet is a late-seventies runner in layered suede with softer foam. Everyday Arc is a vulcanized canvas low-top that goes with everything. Both are built to be resoled.
choose: Choose Metro Quiet for all-day cushioning and a retro running shape.
Choose Everyday Arc for a flat, flexible canvas classic under ₹8,000.

guide.p: Removable cork-blend insoles and roomy toe boxes keep them comfortable from the commute to dinner.
Suede looks sharper and wants a brush. Canvas goes out in any weather and softens with age.
When the sole wears through, we replace it and clean the upper for ₹3,499.
